event.title: Add a simple in-memory session cache
event.body: Adds a new `src/cache.py` module with a small session cache and wires it into the existing auth path. Includes tests.
event.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/cache.py
@@
+_store = {}
+
+def get(key):
+    return _store.get(key)
+
+def put(key, value):
+    _store[key] = value
